title: In JetBrains WebStorm before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 code execution was possible in untrusted projects via the Angular CLI…
description: A code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains WebStorm versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4. This flaw allows code execution in untrusted projects via the Angular CLI schematics loader. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.3, indicating a medium severity level.
